none: PAS SOM-F5D182: Finger form Roman statue
contea di ritrovamento: Somerset (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman gilded copper alloy finger, probably part of a larger statue or to hold an inscription in place. The human finger is lifesized (for a large person) and broken just beyond the second joint with an old, patinated and worn, break. The details of the finger joints and nail are finely moulded. The nail bed is distinctly stepped down from the rest of the finger and the end section of finger…
